Antigravity connection

One installation connects Motet to existing Antigravity chats on this computer.

Checking connection…

After setup, enable Motet Navigation in Antigravity's Customizations → Installed, then open it from Extensions in any existing chat.

Opening a chat sends no message and starts no new work.

Motet memory

Keep saved activity available to Motet. Recording starts when enabled, while Motet is running; earlier activity is not imported.

Recording

Recording off · 30 day retention

Exclusions and deletion

Excluded chats and projects stop adding new memory. Deleting saved entries is separate.

Privacy and recording coverage

Memory is saved locally. When you ask Motet, relevant excerpts may be sent to its configured model. Saved messages can contain private information. Pauses, exclusions and time when Motet was not running leave gaps.
